en: A multi-view postcard featuring four prominent historical landmarks. The top left image shows a large domed building in a city square with a fountain; the top right image features a Romanesque cathedral with four towers and a statue in front; the bottom left image includes a mosque with a minaret next to a pink building; the bottom right image shows a medieval stone castle wall with a round tower. At the center of the postcard is a coat of arms featuring a star and fortress motif.
